# LoopSound <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
LoopSound:Void sound:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sound` | In | Int32 | required | A handle from [LoadSound](LoadSound). |

## Description

Marks a sound so that it plays in an endless loop whenever it is played from now on. It does not start the sound: call [PlaySound](PlaySound) for that. Channels that already play the sound are not changed. Stop a looping sound with [StopChannel](StopChannel).

## Differences

* There is no command to switch looping off again.
* A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
LoopSound snd
Local ch = PlaySound(snd)
Delay 1800
StopChannel ch
```
